messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: GPU_POOL_THROTTLE in us-west-2. 80% of requests seeing >2s token latency and intermittent 503s. Escalation: oncall@sre.

sara (oncall): seeing it. I’m on the bridge. digging into autoscaler logs now.

mike (infra): flagging that spot eviction rate spiked in us-west-2 02:03 UTC, pools reported `ScaleDownFailed` errors. sending pool snapshot to thread.

sara (oncall): thanks. initial customer impact: multiple hosted API customers reporting increased latencies and ~1% 5xx. routing policy pushed fallback to egress-region after 02:10 but still some requests queued.

james (runtime): KV cache pressure + increased LB retries causing tail latencies. I can temporarily reduce KV cache retention to free memory on hot pods: `curl -X POST /admin/cache?ttl=30` on affected runtime. Want me to do that?

sara (oncall): yes do it. mark in incident timeline.

james (runtime): done. applied to pool=west-gpu-hot at 02:18 UTC. dropping KV TTL to 30s. cpu/mem reclaimed on nodes, some pods restarted.

jenna (ops): autoscaler logs show controller failed to create new nodes due to quota errors on AWS account for us-west-2. quota request in progress but not approved.

mike (infra): workarounds: 1) temporarily shift 25% of traffic to us-east-1, 2) spin up preemptible fallback nodes in us-west-2 with a different instance type (g5a instead of g5). Which do we want now?

sara (oncall): shift traffic first — less invasive. lex, can we authorize region shift for hosted tier?

lex (pm): authorize. prioritize PLG free-tier and enterprise customers equally for now. Coordinate with support for comms.

oliver (support): will draft status update to affected customers. ETA for message: 02:40 UTC. note: some customers already opened tickets. linking INF-4332.

mike (infra): executing traffic shift at 02:24 UTC. `route update --from us-west-2 --to us-east-1 --percent 25 --dry=false`

sara (oncall): seeing immediate drop in queue length and 5xx rate down from 1% to 0.3% within 6m of shift. still some residual latency for sessions pinned to hot nodes.

james (runtime): as a medium-term mitigation I rolled out a lower-precision model variant (quantized v2) for the most latency-sensitive route; this reduces per-token latency at a minor cost to quality. rolled to 10% traffic at 02:45 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident created: INF-2026-03-17-07. Postmortem owner requested.

sara (oncall): post-incident actions we need: 1) quota change follow-through with cloud team (owner: mike) 2) autoscaler failure root cause and fix (owner: james) 3) improved cross-region routing playbook (owner: lex) 4) customer comms retrospective (owner: oliver) 5) add pre-warm capacity alarm (owner: jenna). I’ll schedule the postmortem meeting.

mike (infra): filing cloud quota ticket now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4332. added notes + logs.

james (runtime): I’ll investigate controller panic that caused ScaleDownFailed. initial suspect: race in node group reconciliation when instance types are heterogeneous.

jenna (ops): action to add a proactive autoscaler test to our canary pipeline. will add task to infra backlog.

lex (pm): Proposed postmortem meeting: 2026-03-18 16:00 UTC. agenda: timeline, root cause hypothesis, customer impact, mitigations, action owners + deadlines. good?

sara (oncall): good with me. I'll own writeup and initial timeline.

oliver (support): I’ll post the customer update once the postmortem draft is ready.

incident-bot: Follow-up ticket created: INF-4333 (postmortem + action tracker). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4333

sara (oncall): Immediate action items (from this thread) — captured here so we don’t lose them: - mike: complete quota approval (due 2026-03-19) - james: runtime fix PR + test (due 2026-03-22) - jenna: add autoscaler canary (due 2026-03-26) - lex: update routing playbook + runbook (due 2026-03-24) - oliver: customer comms + log of affected customers (due 2026-03-18)

mike (infra): acknowledged. I’ll also scope fallback instance type catalog for future autoscale events.

james (runtime): acknowledging, will tag infra team for any cloud API changes needed.

sara (oncall): thanks everyone. closing out live bridge — summary will be in INF-4333. if you add more items, append to ticket. :white_check_mark:

oliver (support): posting initial customer update now.

incident-bot: Bridge closed at 02:50 UTC.

(End of thread)
